title: CLTR Cutover MarkerAuthorityBinding record
description: Phase 136T, Implementation Group 10 (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.32, Sec.46). A MarkerAuthorityBinding document describes a claimed production marker's association with a specific generation; it never itself creates, writes, or verifies a marker, proves marker freshness, resolves a duplicate-delivery conflict, or authorizes a compatibility fallback (Sec.1, Sec.32, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 2 (_extensions only, Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes all three binding schemas). Not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2), so neither field is declared here. Sec.32's field table lists 'created_at', 'authority_role', and 'digest' as bare top-level fields rather than as part of the uniform envelope/authority_disclosure struct used by every other of the 11 already-implemented families; consistent with those families and with notification_authority_binding.schema.json's own NON-BLOCKING-136T-1 disclosure, this schema applies the uniform envelope + authority_disclosure struct (created_at is the standard envelope field; authority_role is the authority_disclosure.authority_role field; 'digest' is the standard record_digest field) rather than inventing a second, structurally inconsistent representation -- disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136T-2. generation_reference is typed using the dedicated shared/references.schema.json#/$defs/generation_reference shape (id+digest only), consistent with NON-BLOCKING-136N-2/NON-BLOCKING-136T-1 precedent. Sec.32's table does not list a 'limitations' field for this family; this schema nonetheless includes it, since every one of the 11 already-implemented families (including the other two Tier 2 binding-adjacent families, concurrency_conflict and recovery_journal_entry) carries the universal limitations array, and Sec.14 itself groups all three binding schemas into the same Tier 2 policy as those families -- treated as a table omission, not an intentional exclusion, disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136T-3.

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the MarkerAuthorityBinding schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2. Restates Sec.32's 'digest' field (NON-BLOCKING-136T-2).

created_at.description: Always present (Sec.32). Documentation only; Layer 4 compares against authority-state freshness to detect a stale marker -- this schema validates shape only.

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1). marker_authority_binding is not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2).

generation_reference.description: Always present (Sec.32). Pins this marker to exactly one generation (prevents a wrong-generation marker). See NON-BLOCKING-136T-1/NON-BLOCKING-136N-2 disclosure for the generation_reference-versus-record_reference typing choice.

state.description: Always present (Sec.32). Record-local MarkerState (Sec.8.8, 4 values), home schema this file per Sec.8.8's specific per-family table. 'conflict' requires duplicate_of (enforced below). A schema-valid state value never itself proves the marker's actual production state (Layer 4/5).

duplicate_of.description: Conditionally present: the key is required when state is 'conflict', omitted otherwise (Sec.32). When present, nullable -- null when the first (duplicated) marker is not yet known, a record_reference to it otherwise. Prevents an unacknowledged second marker for the same generation from silently coexisting rather than referencing the first.

compatibility_fallback_forbidden.description: Always present (Sec.32). Schema-pinned to true, documenting the prohibition on compatibility fallback even though enforcing it operationally is a Layer 6 concern.

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless (marker-as-authority is structurally prevented). A valid MarkerAuthorityBinding record never itself proves a marker was actually written, is fresh, or resolves a duplicate-delivery conflict.

_extensions.description: Conditionally present: the single reserved Tier 2 extension key (Sec.14). String-valued map only, no nested arbitrary structure. Forward-compatible annotation only; never authority-bearing, never interpreted as marker creation.

duplicate_of.description: Nullable record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'marker_authority_binding' (this record's own family -- a duplicate marker always references another marker), with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule, applied here even though the family is identical, since this is a distinct-document cross-reference, not a same-document embedding).

self_family_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'marker_authority_binding'.
